lint/refuse-marker-key-vector-drift-from.reason: reads the agentibrain kernel dev checkout an earlier step clones into .marker-kernel

lint/refuse-changelog-fragments-named-of.reason: its BRANCH env reads github.head_ref and github.ref_name, which the lab context does not supply

lint/fail-on-known-vulnerabilities-new-a.reason: runs pip-audit through uvx against the online vulnerability database

lint/run-every-swarm-ledger-dashboard-qu.reason: requires the antoncore checkout, the installed dashboard checker and a running ClickHouse container; its checkout producer needs network access

lint/hold-the-hive-member-nats-grants-eq.reason: reads the antoncore checkout in .antoncore and pip installs cryptography

lint/artifact-sanity-checks.reason: its artifact selector reads github.base_ref, github.event.before and github.event.merge_group.base_sha, which the lease does not supply; the gate also needs the browser installed by earlier setup

lint/prove-the-mutation-gate-kills-with-.reason: its self-plant producer compares the head inputs with the base; the identical dev twin has no changed input, so the gate is skipped instead of proving an executed green result

type-gate/install-dependencies.reason: a setup step that grades nothing; its Python and cache actions are skipped by the static runner and the dependency fallback needs PyPI access

semgrep/scan/fail-on-findings-new-agains.reason: its baseline producer supplies BASE, but its CONFIGS name Semgrep registry rule packs fetched online

semgrep/charts/guard-rules-hold-on-their.reason: fetches the base branch from origin before it grades

test-count/install-dependencies.reason: its Python and cache actions are skipped by the static runner and the dependency fallback needs PyPI access

test-count/fetch-the-base-suite-count-re.reason: its app token action is skipped by the static runner, leaving no successful action outcome or token for downloading the suite count artifact from GitHub

test-count/record-the-head-count-for-the.reason: skipped because the supplied event is pull_request and this step requires merge_group; it also reads a suite count collected earlier in that job
